question: Mubvunzo
defaultDirections: Sarudza mhinduro yaunofunga kuti inopindura mubvunzo. Kana wapedza, dzvanya {checkAnswer}. Uchawana mhinduro inoratidza kana mhinduro yako yakarurama uye zvekuita zvinotevera.
relatedContentDescription: Izvi zvinogadzira nzvimbo yakapetwa yezvinoenderana nemubvunzo uyu uye zvinogara zvichiratidzwa
hintDescription: Izvi zvinoratidzwa kana mushandisi akakanganisa mhinduro
evidenceDescription: Izvi zvinoratidzwa kana mushandisi akarurama mhinduro
crosswordDirections: Nyora tsamba imwe mubhokisi chena rimwe nerimwe. Makiyi emiseve anofamba pakati pemabhokisi. Sarudza bhokisi zvakare, kana dzvanya Space, kuti uchinje pakati pekuyambuka nekudzika. Sarudza pfungwa kuti usvetukire kushoko rayo. Kana wapedza, dzvanya {checkAnswer}.
startHint: Sarudza bhokisi kana pfungwa kuti utange.
addWords: Wedzera mazwi nepfungwa muzvirongwa kuti uvake crossword. Gridi inogadzirirwa iwe.
answerKey: Kiyi yemhinduro. Vadzidzi havamboone mavara aya.
unplacedHelp: Mazwi aya haana kukwanisa kuiswa, saka vadzidzi havazoaoni. Chinja izwi kuti rigovane tsamba neimwe izwi, kana ribvise.
